import { relay } from "./service";

export function entry(payload: string): string {
  return relay(payload);
}

export function operationEntry(operationPayload: string): string {
  relay(operationPayload);
  return "handled";
}

export function unrelated(unrelatedPayload: string): string {
  return "unchanged";
}

export function overwritten(obsolete: string, replacement: string): string {
  let value = obsolete;
  value = replacement;
  return value;
}

export function callback(unusedContext: object): string {
  return "callback contract";
}

export function preserveEffect(effect: () => void): string {
  const unused = effect();
  return "initializer must remain";
}
